lines: Koi yeh kaise bataye ke woh tanha kyun hai
couplets.en: How can anyone say why he is alone?

lines: Woh jo apna tha wohi aur kisi ka kyun hai
couplets.en: Why does the one who was mine now belong to someone else?

lines: Yahi duniya hai to phir aisi yeh duniya kyun hai
couplets.en: If this is the world, why must it be this way?

lines: Yahi hota hai to aakhir yahi hota kyun hai
couplets.en: If this is how things go, why do they always go this way?

lines: Ik zara haath badha de to pakad le daaman
couplets.en: If he reached out just a little, he could catch the hem.

lines: Uske seene mein sama jaaye hamari dhadkan
couplets.en: My heartbeat could find its home in his chest.

lines: Itni qurbat hai to phir faasla itna kyun hai
couplets.en: If we are so close, why are we so far apart?

lines: Dil-e-barbaad se nikla nahin ab tak koi
couplets.en: No one has yet left this ruined heart.

lines: Ik lute ghar pe diya karta hai dastak koi
couplets.en: Someone keeps knocking at the door of a house stripped bare.

lines: Aas jo toot gayi phir se bandhata kyun hai
couplets.en: Why does he rekindle a hope that has already broken?

lines: Tum masarrat ka kaho ya ise gham ka rishta
couplets.en: Call it a bond of joy or a bond of sorrow.

lines: Kehte hain pyaar ka rishta hai janam ka rishta
couplets.en: They say the bond of love lasts a lifetime.

lines: Hai janam ka jo yeh rishta to badalta kyun hai
couplets.en: If this bond is for a lifetime, why does it change?
